mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/50a69085f677-t1/ws/prep; cd /srv/leakruns/50a69085f677-t1/ws/prep; cat > prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_E0E0 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 테이블과 분할 생성 (학습 없음)."""
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

D = "../data/"
design = json.load(open("../design_E0E0.json"))
p = pd.read_csv(D + "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D + "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D + "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D + "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D + "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# tp = 퇴원 시각 + 0h
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()

# 결과: 다음 입원의 admit_time 이 (tp, tp+30d] 안
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) &
                    (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
a["followup_complete"] = (a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c["age"] >= 18]
c = c[c["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()

# 특징
c["los_h"] = (c["discharge_time"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 같은 환자의 이전 입원 수 (사망 입원 제외 전 기준으로 다시 계산)
c["n_prior_adm"] = c["admission_id"].map(a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().set_axis(a["admission_id"]))

# 진단: 시각 없음 → 해당(index) 입원 진단만 사용, ICD 앞자리(prefix) 매칭
dxi = dx[dx["admission_id"].isin(c["admission_id"])]
c["n_dx"] = c["admission_id"].map(dxi.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, pre in [("dx_ckd", "N18"), ("dx_chf", "I50")]:
    ids = set(dxi.loc[dxi["icd_code"].str.startswith(pre), "admission_id"])
    c[name] = c["admission_id"].isin(ids).astype(int)

def windowed(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m[tcol] <= m["tp"])]

lw = windowed(labs, "report_time")
c["hgb_min"] = c["admission_id"].map(lw[lw["test"] == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())
cr = lw[lw["test"] == "creatinine"].sort_values("report_time")
c["cr_last"] = c["admission_id"].map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
ow = windowed(orders, "order_time")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c["admission_id"].isin(
    ow.loc[ow["order_type"] == "dialysis_order", "admission_id"]).astype(int)

# 분할: split_unit=family. family_id 결측(≈80% 환자)은 patient_id 로 대체한 그룹 단위 holdout
c["group_id"] = c["family_id"].fillna(c["patient_id"])
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = c["group_id"].unique()
rng.shuffle(groups)
test_groups = set(groups[: int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
c["split"] = np.where(c["group_id"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
out = c[["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "group_id", "tp", "followup_complete",
         "split", "readmit_30d"] + feats]
out.to_csv("model_table.csv", index=False)

print("cohort", len(out), "patients", out.patient_id.nunique(), "groups", out.group_id.nunique())
print("outcome rate", out.readmit_30d.mean().round(4), "incomplete followup", (~out.followup_complete).sum())
print(out.groupby("split").agg(n=("readmit_30d", "size"), rate=("readmit_30d", "mean")))
print(out.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]))
print("missing:\n", out[feats].isna().sum()[lambda s: s > 0])
print("group overlap train/test:", len(set(out[out.split == "train"].group_id) & set(out[out.split == "test"].group_id)))
# 참고: 설계서대로 admission_id 로 나누면 같은 환자가 양쪽에 들어가는 정도
rng2 = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
te = rng2.random(len(out)) < 0.3
print("admission_id 분할 시 train/test 공유 환자 수:",
      len(set(out.patient_id[te]) & set(out.patient_id[~te])),
      "/ 공유 가족:", len(set(out.family_id[te].dropna()) & set(out.family_id[~te].dropna())))
EOF
python3 prepare.py
